options.name: anycast_ip_address
options.description: IPv4 address of the anycast host in string format.

options.name: anycast_ipv6_address
options.description: IPv6 address of the anycast host in string format.

options.name: description
options.description: The description for the address object. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the anycast configuration.

options.name: onprem_hosts
options.description: The list of on-prem hosts associated with the anycast configuration. Struct on-prem host reference.

options.name: portal_key
options.description: The API token for authentication against Infoblox BloxOne API. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_KEY) will be used.

options.name: portal_url
options.description: The Infoblox Cloud Services Portal (CSP) URL. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_URL) will be used.

options.name: service
options.description: The type of the Service used in anycast configuration.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the object

options.name: tags
options.description: The tags for the anycast configuration object.
